text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the team, a splendid performance!
Just like the divine prophecy said, 'Where there's a will, there's a way!'

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well now, even so,
the Aoharu Cup is far from over—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I need to head to the shrine right away
to pray for victory in the next race~!"
